# Repo intake

Read `AGENTS.md`, relevant docs/ADRs/DESIGN, target source/callers, tests, package versions, scripts, and current diff. Produce a brief: goal, relevant artifacts/files, allowed scope, existing reuse options, risks, acceptance criteria, and checks.

Do not guess stack conventions or start changes before this intake for substantive work. Exit with a compact build brief.
